messages:
maya: Quick sync — Q4 infra prioritization. Need to lock multi-region onramp sequence, spot backfill playbook, and retention/eviction SLAs by EOW. Customers expecting EU+APAC availability for Dedicated. Who can own tradeoffs?
rohit: I can lead prioritization. Proposal: 1) EU primary region (low-latency for EU customers), 2) APAC pilot (limited sku set + spot fallback), 3) global burst via partner pockets. This aligns with Q4 OKR 1.2.
jess: Question — for product launch criteria, we need: SLOs (p95 < 120ms for embeddings, p50 text gen < 200ms), failover test pass, and regression benchmark within 2% of quality. Can infra confirm feasibility?
rohit: Agree on SLOs, but p95 120ms for embeddings in APAC with current H100 mix is optimistic. We either: a) reserve a small Dedicated pool in APAC, or b) accept higher tail latency and mitigate via routing. Need decision by Wed.
liam: Cost view: reserving APAC Dedicated adds ~$Xk/mo; spot backfill cuts incremental CPU cost by ~45% but has eviction risk. We should model 3 scenarios (reserve-heavy, hybrid, spot-first). I'll run numbers with expected customer load.
sarah: Ops considerations: spot backfill playbook must include prefix cache warmup, KV cache snapshot restore and a warmup window (5-10min). Also add automatic rollback to last-known-good model when eviction rate > 20% over 10min. Pasting a snippet for the eviction policy: ```if eviction_rate > 0.2 for window(10m): switch_to_reserved_pool() alert #oncall notify```
noah: Procurement timeline: typical lead time for H100 fleet is 12-18 weeks from PO. If we want APAC Dedicated in Q4 ramp, we need POs placed in next 10 days with vendor confirmation. Also need customs/colocation turnaround buffer.
jess: For customer-driven asks: two enterprise prospects need APAC at GA to start trials; can we offer a "pilot reserved" w/ strict commit 3mo? Might buy us runway.
rohit: Pilot reserved OK but we need a gating checklist: capacity smoke test, regional failover smoke, billing test, security review. Owners: @sarah (ops test), @maya (security), @liam (cost signoff), @jess (customer comms).
maya: I'll run security checklist. Quick note: for Private deployments we also need KMS region parity. If APAC doesn't support our KMS key management vendor, we need a fallback.
ops-bot: Deploy preview job queued: region-onramp-smoke-test -> queued on h100-apac-pilot (job #8721). ETA 45m.
liam: Early ask — can we update the cost model doc? Link: https://redwood.internal/cost-models/q4-apac (I'll own).
rohit: Action items: 1) Liam — three cost scenarios by Tue EOD. 2) Noah — firm vendor lead times and PO window by Tue. 3) Sarah — draft spot backfill playbook and rollback policy by Wed. 4) Maya/Jess — finalize launch checklist and customer pilot terms by Fri.
jess: Also suggest we add a measurable OKR: "Reduce cross-region tail latency gap (APAC vs NA) by 30% for production embeddings by end of Q4" — if infra agrees, we'll add to roadmap.
sarah: Agree to OKR if we get pilot reserved capacity for the main 2 customers. Otherwise it's aspirational.
noah: Noted. I'll get vendor confirmations. If we miss PO window, fallback is spot-heavy strategy + routing.
maya: Thanks — let's keep decisions tight. Weekly check-in Thurs 10am. Ping me if anything blocks. :thumbsup:
rohit: Great, will set calendar and update the infra roadmap doc with decisions. :eyes:
